title: [review] project-LICHEN-iaui.3: pre-existing compilation errors in Rust edhoc.rs
description:
This commit (project-LICHEN-iaui.3) is correct — it properly wipes ed_seed in all C code paths and wraps seed in Zeroizing on the Rust side.

HOWEVER, the Rust file rust/lichen-oscore/src/edhoc.rs has pre-existing compilation errors (not introduced by this commit) that were discovered during review:

1. E0252: Duplicate imports of CryptoRng and RngCore at line 33 (redundant with line 32)
2. E0428: Duplicate function definitions for build_context_2 (lines 444, 470), build_context_3 (lines 451, 480), build_signature_structure (lines 458, 491)
3. E0425: PendingMessage2 and PendingMessage3 types referenced but not in scope (lines 750, 837, 1232, 1298) — likely renamed to Lifecycle enum variants
4. E0119: Conflicting Zeroize implementations via #[derive] and manual impl for both EdhocInitiator (line 581) and EdhocResponder (line 954) — double impl conflict

These must be fixed before the crate can compile with --all-features.
